title: Board Title
name: Board Title
purpose: Short statement of what the student can communicate or show.

teacherNotes.modeling: Model key words while speaking; wait; respond to all communication; accept multimodal responses.
teacherNotes.evidence: Teacher can observe selections, repair attempts, comments, and participation in the shared task.
teacherNotes.customisation: Replace labels/search terms with local vocabulary as needed.

sett.student: Describe strengths, preferred modalities, access needs, and communication opportunities without diagnoses or sensitive identifiers.
sett.environment: Describe classroom/device/network/partner conditions that affect access.
sett.task: Describe the learning or participation task and the communication moves needed.
sett.tools: Describe AAC, print, dwell, switch, symbols, partner supports, and fallback options.

engagement: Offer meaningful choice and a safe repair/rest route.
representation: Use short text labels with symbol/photo placeholders and spoken feedback.
actionExpression: Allow touch, keyboard, partner interpretation, and AAC selection as valid response routes.

differentiation.content: Preserve the key learning intent while reducing access load.
differentiation.process: Support modelling, wait time, repeated practice, and multimodal responses.
differentiation.product: Accept selections, partner-observed communication, print evidence, or exported logs as appropriate.
differentiation.environment: Keep student mode calm, predictable, local-first, and offline-aware.
differentiation.support: Teacher/SLP/OT/family team reviews and personalises vocabulary before use.

participationBarriers.barrier: The student may not be able to access the original task through speech, handwriting, or small controls.
participationBarriers.support: Provide large semantic buttons, keyboard fallback, repair vocabulary, and partner modelling.

evidencePlan.notJudgement: Access method and prompt level are recorded as context, not as curriculum judgement.
evidencePlan.export: Use anonymous local notes, CSV, print, or portfolio summary only when needed.

symbolStrategy.customMediaPolicy: teacher-owned local media only unless explicitly approved
